license_required.quote: no person shall use the title "nurse" unless the person is licensed or has been licensed in the past as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse under the Nursing Practice Act

degree_required.value: Approved program of nursing for licensure as a registered nurse
degree_required.quote: furnish evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has successfully completed an approved program of nursing for licensure as a registered nurse and has graduated or is eligible for graduation

exams.name: National licensing examination for registered nurses
exams.quote: Applicants for licensure by examination shall be required to pass the national licensing examination for registered nurses

exams.name: National licensing examination for licensed practical nurses
exams.quote: Applicants for licensure by examination shall be required to pass the national licensing examination for licensed practical nurses

interval_years.quote: renew the license every two years by the end of the applicant's renewal month

required.quote: shall show proof of continuing education as required by the board

available.quote: The board shall issue an expedited license to practice professional registered nursing without an examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed in another licensing jurisdiction and holds a valid, unrestricted license and is in good standing with the licensing board in that licensing jurisdiction

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid, unrestricted license in good standing from another jurisdiction; board shall expedite issuance within thirty days
requirements.quote: The board shall issue an expedited license to practice professional registered nursing without an examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed in another licensing jurisdiction and holds a valid, unrestricted license and is in good standing with the licensing board in that licensing jurisdiction. The board shall expedite the issuance of a license in accordance with Section 61-1-31.1 NMSA 1978 within thirty days

exists.quote: shall appoint and employ a qualified registered nurse, who shall not be a member of the board, to serve as executive officer to the board

disciplinary_grounds.quote: has willfully or repeatedly violated any provisions of the Nursing Practice Act, including any rule adopted by the board pursuant to that act

definition_quote.value: assisting individuals, families or communities in maintaining or attaining optimal health, assessing and implementing a plan of care to accomplish defined goals and evaluating responses to care and treatment
definition_quote.quote: assisting individuals, families or communities in maintaining or attaining optimal health, assessing and implementing a plan of care to accomplish defined goals and evaluating responses to care and treatment

value: promoting and supporting optimal human functions and responses
establishing an environment conducive to well-being
collaborating on the health care regimen
maintaining accountability for safe and effective nursing care
methods_authorized.quote: initiating and maintaining comfort measures; promoting and supporting optimal human functions and responses; establishing an environment conducive to well-being or to the support of a dignified death; collaborating on the health care regimen; administering medications and performing treatments prescribed by a person authorized in this state or in any other state in the United States to prescribe them; recording and reporting nursing observations, assessments, interventions and responses to health care; providing counseling and health teaching; delegating and supervising nursing interventions that may be performed safely by others and are not in conflict with the Nursing Practice Act; and maintaining accountability for safe and effective nursing care

drug_authority.value: Administering medications prescribed by authorized persons
drug_authority.quote: administering medications and performing treatments prescribed by a person authorized in this state or in any other state in the United States to prescribe them

license_tiers.quote: "registered nurse" means a nurse who practices professional registered nursing; "licensed practical nurse" means a nurse who practices licensed practical nursing; "certified nurse practitioner" means a registered nurse who is licensed by the board for advanced practice as a certified nurse practitioner; "certified registered nurse anesthetist" means a registered nurse who is licensed by the board for advanced practice as a certified registered nurse anesthetist; "certified clinical nurse specialist" means a registered nurse who is licensed by the board for advanced practice as a certified clinical nurse specialist

aprn_role_categories.quote: "advanced practice" means the practice of professional registered nursing by a registered nurse who has been prepared through additional formal education as provided in Sections 61-3-23.2 through 61-3-23.4 NMSA 1978 to function beyond the scope of practice of professional registered nursing, including certified nurse practitioners, certified registered nurse anesthetists and certified clinical nurse specialists

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "licensed practical nursing" means the practice of a directed scope of nursing requiring basic knowledge of the biological, physical, social and behavioral sciences and nursing procedures, which practice is at the direction of a registered nurse, physician or dentist licensed to practice in this state

full_independent_practice_available.quote: Certified registered nurse anesthetists shall function in either an independent role or in collaboration with other health care providers in accordance with the policies of a health care facility

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: prescription and distribution of dangerous drugs and controlled substances included in Schedules II through V of the Controlled Substances Act

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: maintain a permanent register of all certified hemodialysis technicians

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: A statewide program for certification of medication aides and approval of medication aide training programs is created under the board

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: delegating and supervising nursing interventions that may be performed safely by others and are not in conflict with the Nursing Practice Act

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: A health care facility shall not retaliate against, demote, suspend, terminate, discipline, discriminate against or report any action to the board of nursing when a nurse makes a good faith request for safe harbor

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is entered into law and entered into with all other jurisdictions legally joining therein
